items.title: Promote the reviewed execution plan into the canonical decisions corpus
items.context: Preserve the evidence-calibrated /tmp document as docs/requirements/decisions/role-prompt-modularization-and-budget-execution-plan.md without changing runtime behavior.
items.userSees: The reviewed plan is durable in the repository decision source of truth.

happy.desc: Using the reviewed source identified by SHA-256 3a7e9beaf60b692753de91ee50eeacccdadfd57586fb28b6d07189d953b60610, decision_doc_preview for the reviewed DDP proposal renders the canonical target docs/requirements/decisions/role-prompt-modularization-and-budget-execution-plan.md with Status: accepted, Source story: B-7ffc, Source proposal, Created, and the documented Decision/Context/Scope/Non-Goals/Options Considered/Chosen Approach/Operational Rules/Verification Requirements/Risks/Supersession wrapper; decision_doc_save create materializes that reviewed proposal at the exact canonical path.

A deterministic content-equivalence check proves that the complete substantive reviewed plan is embedded under Chosen Approach: the source H1 text maps exactly to the generated document H1; after the canonical Chosen Approach introduction, every source heading outside fenced code is demoted by exactly one level, while every other source line is preserved in order. The resulting plan still contains all substantive prose, tables, identifiers, 18 fence delimiters, seven ordered Story milestones, and the separate conditional budget-enforcement follow-up.

edge.desc: The heading transformation is fence-aware: opening and closing fence delimiters and every line inside each fenced block remain byte-for-byte unchanged, including lines that begin with #; only Markdown ATX headings outside fences receive one additional #, with no heading skipped, double-demoted, or promoted beyond its canonical nesting under Chosen Approach.

Rendered output is reproducible across preview and save: compute SHA-256 with the repository digestText algorithm over the exact Markdown payload rendered by decision_doc_preview, then require decision_doc_save renderedDocDigest, the persisted decision_doc_save process-event renderedDocDigest, and digestText of the saved target bytes to equal that preview digest. A stale proposal digest, different preview, or post-save edit fails verification.

adversarial.desc: Normalize the saved document by removing only the documented canonical wrapper/provenance fields, the canonical Chosen Approach introduction, mapping the generated H1 back to the reviewed source H1, and reversing exactly one fence-external heading demotion; the normalized result must equal the reviewed source content. Any other paraphrase, omission, insertion into the embedded plan, reordered milestone, changed role status, altered budget threshold, encoding corruption, table drift, or code-fence mutation fails even if editorially plausible.

The promotion remains documentation-only: the Story diff attributable to CHK-001 creates the canonical decision document through decision_doc_save and records its local workflow metadata, but changes no runtime source, Prompt asset, registry, configuration, handler, gate, package version, generated runtime artifact, or test behavior; NAV discovery remains the separate CHK-002 concern, and the accepted plan is not represented as completed implementation evidence.

items.title: Expose the promoted plan through requirements navigation
items.context: Add a concise navigation entry so later Stories and reviewers can find the canonical plan without relying on the temporary file.
items.userSees: The canonical requirements navigation links to the promoted plan.

happy.desc: docs/requirements/NAV.md contains a descriptive Markdown entry whose relative target is exactly decisions/role-prompt-modularization-and-budget-execution-plan.md; resolving that link from NAV.md reaches the promoted canonical document, so a reader can discover and open the plan without using /tmp.

edge.desc: After promotion, navigation metadata remains internally accurate: the direct decisions-document inventory count is updated if the new file changes it, and the plan has exactly one canonical navigation entry with no duplicate entry or alternate repository path.

The navigation entry preserves the curated decisions list structure and uses the actual promoted document title and path with exact case, punctuation, and .md suffix so it resolves on case-sensitive filesystems.

adversarial.desc: Repository search proves docs/requirements/NAV.md does not link to /tmp, /private/tmp, the attachment path, an absolute local filesystem path, or any compatibility/staging copy; deleting the temporary source would not break discovery of the canonical plan.

A link-resolution check from docs/requirements/NAV.md must fail for typoed, missing, directory-traversing, or non-canonical targets; acceptance requires the checked-in target under docs/requirements/decisions and must not be satisfied by matching link text alone.

The navigation wording must not claim that the execution plan has already changed runtime behavior, completed its numbered implementation Stories, or enabled budget enforcement; it exposes a plan-only decision record whose later Stories remain responsible for implementation.

auditLog.reason: Canonical decision doc has been saved; recording implementation state before committing and attaching evidence.
